offer.text: Protect this contact from five zombies. This is civilian defense, not authority to harm residents. Payment: eight emeralds. This commission answers one recorded regional opportunity or signed voluntary obligation.

accept.text: Protect the issuer while preserving civilian law.

in_progress.text: Defeat five zombies threatening this issuer.

ready.text: The defense is complete; report to the original issuer.

complete.text: Civilian defense is acknowledged. Eight emeralds are paid.
